issue_context.summary: With Ctrl and Alt swapped in Keyboard Manager, a double-click somewhere in WeChat reportedly closes the WeChat window instead of performing the normal action.

PowerToys version 0.100.2 was installed by auto-update.
The problem is tied to enabling a Ctrl/Alt swap and occurs in WeChat.
inferences: The result could depend on whether the click targets the title bar, tray area, message content, or another control, and may involve WeChat-specific shortcut handling rather than a generic double-click failure.
issue_context.analysis: The translation resolves the language gap, so it should not be requested again. The remaining questions are narrowly tied to reproduction and deciding whether to investigate Keyboard Manager key-state output or application-specific behavior.

comment.body: Thanks for adding the English description: the useful detail is that swapping Ctrl and Alt makes a double-click in WeChat close the window. To distinguish a Keyboard Manager key-state problem from a WeChat-specific window gesture, could you retest on the current PowerToys release and provide the WeChat version, numbered steps, and the exact surface you double-click (for example title bar, conversation area, tray icon, or another control)? A short recording without private chat content would help. Immediately after reproducing, please add a comment containing /bugreport and attach the generated ZIP so the active remap and hook state can be checked.
